fixed.initial_physical_arrays: identical to PR180 positive-cloud input; only the two policy attributes differ

stages.name: day
stages.condition: both hour integrations complete inside the existing supported scope and diagnostics resolve no unexplained numerical failure
stages.restart_history_overlap: all common history times after checkpoint (21610 s), first next output 21900 s; retained call at 21630 s

criteria.completion: SUCCESS COMPLETE WRF, no fatal, finite prognostic and radiative history values through the declared end time; no unexamined negative hydrometeor or number state
criteria.scope_exit: Existing cold/frozen/unsupported-state fatal is SCOPE_REJECTED, not numerical failure or successful completion. Preserve the original requested duration and first available state; no guard removal, changed input, shortened success window or automatic day run.
criteria.restart: For a completed hour integration, restart at 1810 s between radiation calls and compare every common Time-dependent history array over overlap byte-for-byte; tags, held clear/all-sky LW/SW/total tendencies, STEPRA and next capture phase must agree.
criteria.day_night: A completed 24-hour run must include actual daytime and nighttime solar diagnostics and expected radiation call phases. One-hour completion alone cannot pass this item.
criteria.water: Use same-time host dry layer mass, Delta(m*q), total rain accumulator once, and actual available integrated surface source. Report inventory and source differences without replacing known common PBL/PD accounting by a zero-residual criterion. Missing actual source diagnostics imply NOT_ASSESSED rather than budget PASS.
criteria.radiation_energy: Reuse same-precision native Q and C*heating contract and the already established held-theta time definition. History-only rounded flux differences cannot certify applied-energy closure. Missing actual-application records imply NOT_ASSESSED.
criteria.comparison: 00/11 state feedback is not a same-state engine comparison and is not an accuracy test. No requirement that differences vanish.
criteria.science: No observational acceptance, whole-model energy acceptance or original-LUT PSD certification; retain all seven closure conditions and production_accepted=false. No new scientific thresholds inferred from these outcomes.

stop_rule: Classify the discriminator first. Scope or numerical rejection ends the day/night campaign for this unchanged input; report the limiting state, not an invented fix or a passing shorter duration.

restart_output_schedule_amendment.reason: Unmodified output alarm restore uses time-to-next-ring=290 s as recurring output interval. Original full restart is preserved; its eight common history times already match all 214 arrays. A 10-minute existing-option probe confirms corrected output cadence.
restart_output_schedule_amendment.note: Output timer configuration only; retain the preregistered 21610 s checkpoint, 21630 s first next radiation, 86400 s end and every originally expected common history time.
